description: Generate a structured unmet need section for HTA dossiers (NICE STA, EMA, FDA, IQWiG, HAS, JCA, GVD, AMCP). Consume-only: first retrieve evidence with literature_search, then pass only cited facts across 4 HEOR dimensions — disease burden, treatment landscape, QoL impact, economic burden. By default (auto_check_regulatory=true), automatically checks current regulatory status of comparators in treatment_landscape.current_soc via primary-source databases (OpenFDA/EMA EPI) and injects verbatim label quotes with auto-numbered citations. Degrades gracefully on API errors — never blocks dossier output. Set auto_check_regulatory:false to skip. Produces a standardised markdown section plus a 1-paragraph unmet_need_summary for downstream tools. Pipe unmet_need_summary into hta_dossier(unmet_need_summary:...) to pre-fill NICE Section B (unmet need) or GVD Section 4. Design log #23 + #26.

auto_check_regulatory.description: When true (default), automatically fans out regulatory.status_check for each drug in treatment_landscape.current_soc × inferred regions. Injects verbatim label quotes inline with auto-numbered citations. Set false to skip (pre-v1.10.1 behaviour). Design log #26.

economic_burden.description: Direct and indirect economic burden of the disease

jurisdictions.description: Target market(s) for this unmet need assessment

literature_evidence.description: Optional: pass literature_search results here to include as supporting evidence

qol_impact.description: Patient-reported and health-related quality of life impact

eq5d_decrement.description: EQ-5D utility decrement vs general population

treatment_landscape.description: Current standard of care and its limitations. Use only evidence retrieved by literature_search or other audited sources. Regulatory/approval claims require current label/regulatory citation support; if not confirmed, leave out rather than infer.

current_soc.description: Molecule names for current standard of care, supported by cited guideline/label/HTA evidence where possible.

qualitative_summary.description: Cited narrative summary only. Do not assert off-label/no pediatric approval/no approved options unless current regulatory sources confirmed it.

name: evidence.unmet_need
